items.q: How is AgentWork different from traditional AI coding tools?
items.a: AgentWork goes beyond code completion. It's an AI agent workstation with multi-Agent DAG parallel collaboration, AST-Native code cognition engine, and compile-time verification guardrails — elevating AI from assistant to real productivity.

items.q: Which programming languages does AgentWork support?
items.a: Through the AST-Native engine, AgentWork supports 20+ mainstream programming languages including Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, with cross-language contract listening.
AgentWork runs natively via Tauri 2 desktop. TimeFlow version control is fully local. Enterprise plans support private deployment — your data never leaves your infrastructure.

items.q: Are 2 AI Employees in Starter enough?
items.a: Starter (¥399/month) includes 2 AI employees + 1 industry template, ideal for individual developers or small projects. For team collaboration, consider Team or Professional plans.
All plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. Full core features are available during the trial.
Professional and above plans support custom industry templates. Enterprise plans include dedicated customization services.

items.q: How do AI employees and AI teams actually work?
items.a: You describe your requirement → the Orchestrator agent decomposes it into a DAG → distributes tasks to Coder, Reviewer, and other role agents for parallel execution. Each agent works in its own Git branch. Results are auto-merged and verified. Just like a real dev team.

Contact sales for a proposal → technical environment assessment → deployment and installation → acceptance and training. The full process takes 2-4 weeks. All data and models run on your servers. Enterprise plan (from ¥1,999/month) includes private deployment option.
